verdict.rationale: mParticle documents a versioned Data Subject Request API (v3, opendsr.mparticle.com) for GDPR/CCPA requests. Its Data Privacy Controls support CCPA data-sale opt-out suppression through forwarding rules that block data from reaching downstream outputs. The evidence does not show deletion requests being propagated to connected destinations, which is the core forwarding part of the story. Missing for 10: documented forwarding of deletion/erasure requests to connected destinations, details of DSR request types and processing workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a privacy lead, I can process user deletion and suppression requests (GDPR/CCPA) and have them forwarded to connected destinations

citations.quote: the Data Subject Request API v3 upgrade guide
